say: Aero's world is built from a few plain shapes rather than detailed models.
Each platform is a white slab standing on a pillar seventy metres tall, which fades to clear as it goes down, so the platforms seem to rise out of the white.
Each ring is a square with a smaller square cut out of its middle, pushed out into a thin slab.
Fourteen gradients are mixed at random when the game starts, and every ring is painted with one of them.
The sea on the title screen is nearly twelve thousand ones and zeros, moved by a shader, and it ripples outward wherever you click.
